title: Mosaic Grid & Token Cartography playbook — modular Cost Canvas and Rollout gating
creator: Avery Chen
description: Develop a playbook and Figma library updates for a modular 'Mosaic Grid' pattern used across Cost Canvas, Dashboards, and Rollout inspector panels. Goal is to: 1) codify token mappings (spacing, elevation, type, density) for mosaic/card permutations, 2) provide responsive rules for 3 breakpoints and density states, 3) deliver concrete component variants and a migration guide for the Console component library and engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Figma library contains a Mosaic Grid component with documented token mappings for spacing, surface, and type
Three responsive templates (desktop, tablet, compact) with token-driven variants are published in the library
Handoff spec and migration playbook created and linked to a Confluence page
Frontend engineers have an agreed props matrix (density, variant, highlight) and a follow-up PR scheduled
Accessibility checks documented: color contrast, keyboard focus order, screen reader labels
comments: 2025-03-02 — Avery Chen: Initial exploration sketches attached. Focused on reducing vertical rhythm variance between metric tiles at small widths.
2025-03-04 — Malik Thompson (Eng): Noted a performance concern around continuous reflow for dynamic card heights; requested a fixed-row option to avoid layout thrash.
2025-03-06 — Priya Patel: Ran 6 unmoderated user sessions for the compact layout. Users preferred condensed labels over truncation for financial metrics; recommended a two-line microcopy token.
2025-03-08 — Accessibility review (internal): Contrast patch needed on 'muted-value' token when paired with elevation-1. Added recommended token mapping.
2025-03-10 — Design review: Consensus to use token names that map directly to CSS custom properties (e.g., --rdw-spacing-xs, --rdw-surface-elevation-2) to ease dev handoff.
2025-03-11 — Engineering review: Agreed props matrix, asked for an example implementation using CSS Grid + container queries; created ENG-20975 to track prototype implementation.
2025-03-12 — Priya Patel: Updated prototype v3 in Figma and published migration checklist. Ready for final review before handing to Platform UI team.
decisions: Adopt token-first naming convention that mirrors runtime CSS variables to reduce mental impedance during handoff
Include a fixed-row option for performance-sensitive dashboards to avoid layout thrash (implementation detail added to ENG-20975)
Use three canonical density states: roomy, default, compact — each maps to spacing and type scale tokens
Rollout gating: new Mosaic variants will be feature-flagged in the Console rollout inspector for 2-week canaries before full migration
next_steps: Finalize the Figma component auto-layout constraints and publish as 'Mosaic Grid — v1' in the shared library (owner: Priya)
Export token mapping CSV and sync with the tokens repo; create PR against design-tokens (owner: Avery)
Deliver example implementation PR and playground page demonstrating fixed-row vs fluid-row (owner: Malik, ENG-20975)
Schedule cross-functional review with Platform UI and Runtime teams (invite list: PM, Eng, Accessibility)
Add migration checklist to the Console migration confluence page and assign rollout owner
